function configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u17
    --]]
    if u17[u21] ~= nil then

    if v24 ~= nil then

        table.insert(v25, v26:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 113 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v27 = u17[u21].connections
        local v28 = v24.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v27, v28:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v29 = 1
        for _, v30 in pairs(v24:GetChildren()) do
            if v30:IsA("Animation") then
                local v31 = u17[u21].connections
                local v32 = v30.Changed
                table.insert(v31, v32:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 118 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u21
                        [2] = u22
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
                end))
                u17[u21][v29] = {}
                u17[u21][v29].anim = v30
                local v33 = v30:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v33 == nil then
                    u17[u21][v29].weight = 1

                    u17[u21][v29].weight = v33.Value

                u17[u21].totalWeight = u17[u21].totalWeight + u17[u21][v29].weight

        [10] = u44

        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end

        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end

        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

local u80 = 0
function move(p81)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u80
        [2] = u45
        [3] = u8
        [4] = u7
        [5] = u3
        [6] = u4
        [7] = u5
        [8] = u6
        [9] = u43
        [10] = u44
        [11] = u61
    --]]
    local v82 = 1
    local v83 = 1
    local v84 = p81 - u80
    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end
    if u8 == "FreeFall" and u45 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)
            return
        end
        if u8 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
            v85 = true
            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end
    local v88 = getTool()
    if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

function move(p81)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u80
        [2] = u45
        [3] = u8
        [4] = u7
        [5] = u3
        [6] = u4
        [7] = u5
        [8] = u6
        [9] = u43
        [10] = u44
        [11] = u61
    --]]
    local v82 = 1
    local v83 = 1
    local v84 = p81 - u80
    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end
    if u8 == "FreeFall" and u45 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)
            return
        end
        if u8 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
            v85 = true
            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end
    local v88 = getTool()
    if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
        return
    elseif u43 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u3
        [2] = u4
        [3] = u5
        [4] = u6
    --]]
    u3.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    u4.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    u3:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    u4:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    u5:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    u6:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u80 = 0
function move(p81)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u80
        [2] = u45
        [3] = u8
        [4] = u7
        [5] = u3
        [6] = u4
        [7] = u5
        [8] = u6
        [9] = u43
        [10] = u44
        [11] = u61
    --]]
    local v82 = 1
    local v83 = 1
    local v84 = p81 - u80
    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end
    if u8 == "FreeFall" and u45 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)
            return
        end
        if u8 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
            v85 = true
            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end
    local v88 = getTool()
    if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

    --]]

        end))
        local v27 = u17[u21].connections
        local v28 = v24.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v27, v28:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v29 = 1
        for _, v30 in pairs(v24:GetChildren()) do
            if v30:IsA("Animation") then
                local v31 = u17[u21].connections
                local v32 = v30.Changed
                table.insert(v31, v32:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 118 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u21
                        [2] = u22
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
                end))

                u17[u21].totalWeight = u17[u21].totalWeight + u17[u21][v29].weight

        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()

        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil

    end

function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:

        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end

    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight

        end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function playAnimation(p45, p46, p47)

    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
        [2] = u29
        [3] = u31
        [4] = u32
        [5] = u27
        [6] = u30
    --]]
    local v48 = math.random(1, u7[p45].totalWeight)
    local v49 = 1
    while u7[p45][v49].weight < v48 do
        v48 = v48 - u7[p45][v49].weight
        v49 = v49 + 1
    end
    local v50 = u7[p45][v49].anim
    if v50 ~= u29 then
        if u31 ~= nil then
            u31:Stop(p46)
            u31:Destroy()

        u31:Play(p46)
        u27 = p45
        u29 = v50
        if u30 ~= nil then
            u30:disconnect()
        end
        u30 = u31.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
    end
end

function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u35
        [2] = u6
    --]]
    if u35 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u6)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function waitForChild(p1, p2)
    local v3 = p1:findFirstChild(p2)
    if v3 then
        return v3
    end
    repeat
        local v4 = p1.ChildAdded:wait()
    until v4.Name == p2
    return v4
end

            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight

        end
    end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(p41)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u27
        [2] = u28
        [3] = u32
        [4] = u6
    --]]
    if p41 == "End" then
        local v42 = u27

function playAnimation(p45, p46, p47)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
        [2] = u29
        [3] = u31
        [4] = u32
        [5] = u27
        [6] = u30
    --]]
    local v48 = math.random(1, u7[p45].totalWeight)
    local v49 = 1
    while u7[p45][v49].weight < v48 do
        v48 = v48 - u7[p45][v49].weight
        v49 = v49 + 1
    end
    local v50 = u7[p45][v49].anim
    if v50 ~= u29 then
        if u31 ~= nil then
            u31:Stop(p46)
            u31:Destroy()
        end
        u32 = 1
        u31 = p47:LoadAnimation(v50)
        u31:Play(p46)
        u27 = p45
        u29 = v50
        if u30 ~= nil then
            u30:disconnect()
        end
        u30 = u31.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
    end
end

    end
end

function getTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u5
    --]]
    for _, v66 in ipairs(u5:GetChildren()) do
        if v66.className == "Tool" then
            return v66
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function getToolAnim(p67)
    for _, v68 in ipairs(p67:GetChildren()) do
        if v68.Name == "toolanim" and v68.className == "StringValue" then
            return v68
        end
    end
    return nil
end
function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u35
        [2] = u6
    --]]
    if u35 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u6)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

            u36 = 0

function move(p81)
    --[[
    Upvalues:

        [2] = u45
        [3] = u8
        [4] = u7

        [6] = u4
        [7] = u5
        [8] = u6
        [9] = u43
        [10] = u44
        [11] = u61
    --]]
    local v82 = 1
    local v83 = 1
    local v84 = p81 - u80
    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end
    if u8 == "FreeFall" and u45 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)
            return
        end
        if u8 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()

            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)

    if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53

    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70

        u37 = u37 - v71
    end

        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

end

function configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u17
    --]]
    if u17[u21] ~= nil then
        for _, v23 in pairs(u17[u21].connections) do
            v23:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u17[u21] = {}
    u17[u21].count = 0
    u17[u21].totalWeight = 0
    u17[u21].connections = {}
    local v24 = script:FindFirstChild(u21)
    if v24 ~= nil then
        local v25 = u17[u21].connections
        local v26 = v24.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v25, v26:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 113 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v27 = u17[u21].connections
        local v28 = v24.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v27, v28:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v29 = 1
        for _, v30 in pairs(v24:GetChildren()) do
            if v30:IsA("Animation") then
                local v31 = u17[u21].connections
                local v32 = v30.Changed
                table.insert(v31, v32:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 118 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u21
                        [2] = u22
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
                end))
                u17[u21][v29] = {}
                u17[u21][v29].anim = v30
                local v33 = v30:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v33 == nil then
                    u17[u21][v29].weight = 1
                else
                    u17[u21][v29].weight = v33.Value
                end
                u17[u21].count = u17[u21].count + 1
                u17[u21].totalWeight = u17[u21].totalWeight + u17[u21][v29].weight
                v29 = v29 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u17[u21].count <= 0 then
        for v34, v35 in pairs(u22) do
            u17[u21][v34] = {}
            u17[u21][v34].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u17[u21][v34].anim.Name = u21
            u17[u21][v34].anim.AnimationId = v35.id
            u17[u21][v34].weight = v35.weight

            u17[u21].totalWeight = u17[u21].totalWeight + v35.weight
        end
    end
end

    end
end

function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u43
        [2] = u7
    --]]
    if u43 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
        return
    elseif u43 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
        return
    elseif u43 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u7, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
    end
end

local u80 = 0
function move(p81)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u80
        [2] = u45
        [3] = u8
        [4] = u7
        [5] = u3
        [6] = u4
        [7] = u5
        [8] = u6
        [9] = u43
        [10] = u44
        [11] = u61
    --]]
    local v82 = 1
    local v83 = 1
    local v84 = p81 - u80
    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end
    if u8 == "FreeFall" and u45 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)
            return
        end
        if u8 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
            v85 = true
            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end
    local v88 = getTool()
    if v88 and v88:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u17
    --]]

            --[[
            Upvalues:

            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v27 = u17[u21].connections
        local v28 = v24.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v27, v28:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))

        for _, v30 in pairs(v24:GetChildren()) do
            if v30:IsA("Animation") then

                    --[[

                        [2] = u22
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
                end))
                u17[u21][v29] = {}
                u17[u21][v29].anim = v30

                if v33 == nil then
                    u17[u21][v29].weight = 1

                u17[u21].totalWeight = u17[u21].totalWeight + u17[u21][v29].weight
                v29 = v29 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u17[u21].count <= 0 then
        for v34, v35 in pairs(u22) do
            u17[u21][v34] = {}
            u17[u21][v34].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function playAnimation(p45, p46, p47)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
        [2] = u29
        [3] = u31
        [4] = u32
        [5] = u27
        [6] = u30
    --]]
    local v48 = math.random(1, u7[p45].totalWeight)
    local v49 = 1
    while u7[p45][v49].weight < v48 do
        v48 = v48 - u7[p45][v49].weight
        v49 = v49 + 1
    end
    local v50 = u7[p45][v49].anim
    if v50 ~= u29 then
        if u31 ~= nil then
            u31:Stop(p46)
            u31:Destroy()
        end
        u32 = 1
        u31 = p47:LoadAnimation(v50)
        u31:Play(p46)
        u27 = p45
        u29 = v50
        if u30 ~= nil then
            u30:disconnect()
        end
        u30 = u31.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
    end
end

    end

function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u35
        [2] = u6
    --]]
    if u35 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u6)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

    end

function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

    local v3 = p1:findFirstChild(p2)
    if v3 then
        return v3
    end
    repeat
        local v4 = p1.ChildAdded:wait()
    until v4.Name == p2
    return v4
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight

        end
    end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function playAnimation(p45, p46, p47)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
        [2] = u29
        [3] = u31
        [4] = u32
        [5] = u27
        [6] = u30
    --]]
    local v48 = math.random(1, u7[p45].totalWeight)
    local v49 = 1
    while u7[p45][v49].weight < v48 do
        v48 = v48 - u7[p45][v49].weight
        v49 = v49 + 1
    end
    local v50 = u7[p45][v49].anim
    if v50 ~= u29 then
        if u31 ~= nil then
            u31:Stop(p46)
            u31:Destroy()

        u32 = 1

        u31:Play(p46)
        u27 = p45
        u29 = v50
        if u30 ~= nil then
            u30:disconnect()
        end
        u30 = u31.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
    end
end

function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u35
        [2] = u6
    --]]
    if u35 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u6)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()

    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end

function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

        [6] = u36

    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

    if v3 then
        return v3

    until v4.Name == p2
    return v4
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function playAnimation(p45, p46, p47)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
        [2] = u29
        [3] = u31
        [4] = u32
        [5] = u27
        [6] = u30
    --]]
    local v48 = math.random(1, u7[p45].totalWeight)
    local v49 = 1
    while u7[p45][v49].weight < v48 do
        v48 = v48 - u7[p45][v49].weight
        v49 = v49 + 1
    end
    local v50 = u7[p45][v49].anim
    if v50 ~= u29 then
        if u31 ~= nil then
            u31:Stop(p46)
            u31:Destroy()

        u32 = 1
        u31 = p47:LoadAnimation(v50)
        u31:Play(p46)
        u27 = p45
        u29 = v50
        if u30 ~= nil then
            u30:disconnect()
        end
        u30 = u31.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
    end
end

        end
    end
