end
function animateTool()
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u35
        [2] = u6
    --]]
    if u35 == "None" then
        playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Slash" then
        playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, u6)
        return
    elseif u35 == "Lunge" then
        playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, u6)
    end
end
function moveSit()
    RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
    RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
    RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
    LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end
local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function waitForChild(p1, p2)
    local v3 = p1:findFirstChild(p2)
    if v3 then
        return v3
    end
    repeat
        local v4 = p1.ChildAdded:wait()
    until v4.Name == p2
    return v4
end

local u69 = 0
function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight

function configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u7
    --]]
    if u7[u9] ~= nil then
        for _, v11 in pairs(u7[u9].connections) do
            v11:disconnect()
        end
    end
    u7[u9] = {}
    u7[u9].count = 0
    u7[u9].totalWeight = 0
    u7[u9].connections = {}
    local v12 = script:FindFirstChild(u9)
    if v12 ~= nil then
        local v13 = u7[u9].connections
        local v14 = v12.ChildAdded
        table.insert(v13, v14:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 109 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v15 = u7[u9].connections
        local v16 = v12.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v15, v16:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 110 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u9
                [2] = u10
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
        end))
        local v17 = 1
        for _, v18 in pairs(v12:GetChildren()) do
            if v18:IsA("Animation") then
                local v19 = u7[u9].connections
                local v20 = v18.Changed
                table.insert(v19, v20:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
                    --[[
                    Upvalues:
                        [1] = u9
                        [2] = u10
                    --]]
                    configureAnimationSet(u9, u10)
                end))
                u7[u9][v17] = {}
                u7[u9][v17].anim = v18
                local v21 = v18:FindFirstChild("Weight")
                if v21 == nil then
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = 1
                else
                    u7[u9][v17].weight = v21.Value
                end
                u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
                u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + u7[u9][v17].weight
                v17 = v17 + 1
            end
        end
    end
    if u7[u9].count <= 0 then
        for v22, v23 in pairs(u10) do
            u7[u9][v22] = {}
            u7[u9][v22].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
            u7[u9][v22].anim.Name = u9
            u7[u9][v22].anim.AnimationId = v23.id
            u7[u9][v22].weight = v23.weight
            u7[u9].count = u7[u9].count + 1
            u7[u9].totalWeight = u7[u9].totalWeight + v23.weight
        end
    end
end

function move(p70)
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u69
        [2] = u37
        [3] = u26
        [4] = u6
        [5] = u35
        [6] = u36
        [7] = u53
    --]]
    local v71 = p70 - u69
    u69 = p70
    if u37 > 0 then
        u37 = u37 - v71
    end
    if u26 == "FreeFall" and u37 <= 0 then
        playAnimation("fall", 0.2, u6)
    else
        if u26 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u6)
            return
        end
        if u26 == "Running" then
            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u6)
        elseif u26 == "Dead" or (u26 == "GettingUp" or (u26 == "FallingDown" or (u26 == "Seated" or u26 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
            stopAllAnimations()
        end
    end
    local v72 = getTool()
    if v72 and (v72.RequiresHandle or v72:FindFirstChild("Handle")) then
        animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(v72)
        if animStringValueObject then
            u35 = animStringValueObject.Value
            animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
            u36 = p70 + 0.3
        end
        if u36 < p70 then
            u36 = 0
            u35 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u35 = "None"
        u53 = nil
        u36 = 0
    end
end

    local v3 = p1:findFirstChild(p2)
    if v3 then
        return v3
    end

    return v4
end

    u80 = p81
    local v85 = false
    if u45 > 0 then
        u45 = u45 - v84
    end

        playAnimation("fall", 0.3, u7)
    else
        if u8 == "Seated" then
            playAnimation("sit", 0.5, u7)

        end

            playAnimation("walk", 0.1, u7)
        elseif u8 == "Dead" or (u8 == "GettingUp" or (u8 == "FallingDown" or (u8 == "Seated" or u8 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

            v83 = 1
            v82 = 0.1
        end
    end
    if v85 then
        local v86 = p81 * v83
        local v87 = v82 * math.sin(v86)
        u3:SetDesiredAngle(v87 + 0)
        u4:SetDesiredAngle(v87 - 0)
        u5:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
        u6:SetDesiredAngle(-v87)
    end
    local v88 = getTool()

        local v89 = getToolAnim(v88)
        if v89 then
            u43 = v89.Value
            v89.Parent = nil
            u44 = p81 + 0.3
        end
        if u44 < p81 then
            u44 = 0
            u43 = "None"
        end
        animateTool()
    else
        stopToolAnimations()
        u43 = "None"
        u61 = nil
        u44 = 0
    end
end

            --[[

            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))
        local v27 = u17[u21].connections
        local v28 = v24.ChildRemoved
        table.insert(v27, v28:connect(function(_) --[[ Line: 114 ]]
            --[[
            Upvalues:
                [1] = u21
                [2] = u22
            --]]
            configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)
        end))

                    configureAnimationSet(u21, u22)

    end

function u23.canPierse(p36, p37, p38) --[[ Line: 281 ]]
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = u10
    --]]
    local v39 = p38.Instance
    if not (v39 and (v39:IsA("BasePart") and v39:HasTag("BreakableGlass"))) then
        if p36.TerrainRicochetEnabled then
            local v40 = p37:GetVelocity()
            if not v40 then
                return false
            end
            local v41 = v40.Unit
            local v42 = v41.Y
            local v43 = v41.X ^ 2 + v41.Z ^ 2
            local v44 = math.sqrt(v43)
            local v45 = math.atan2(v42, v44)
            local v46 = math.deg(v45)
            local v47 = 0.03 / (math.abs(v46) / 36)
            local v48 = v47 / (v47 + 1)
            if p38.Instance:IsA("Terrain") and math.random() < v48 then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    u10(v39, p38.Position)
    p37:SetVelocity(p37:GetVelocity() * 0.5)
    return true
end

function u23.canPierse(p36, p37, p38) --[[ Line: 281 ]]

        [1] = u10
    --]]
